name: nve-offline-mode
description: Switch NVECode to offline mode from the status bar. Blocks marketplace, update and AI Agent network calls without touching telemetry settings.

nvecode.offlineMode.description: When on, NVECode blocks all marketplace, update and AI Agent network calls. Telemetry is already removed at build time; this toggle is for everything else.

nvecode.offlineMode.blockUpdates.description: Also block update checks while offline mode is on.
